_meta.description: Every adjustable assumption in the Subsidy Math model. Single source for the microsite engine (src/lib/subsidy-math/model.ts) and the Excel workbook (scripts/subsidy-math/build_model.py). basis: D = disclosed in a filing, R = reported estimate, A = our assumption, C = our calculation on disclosed figures.

customerDiscount.note: Negotiated recurring discount off list. Advisory benchmarks put enterprise commit discounts at 5-20% (Redress, CloudForecast).

discountFundedByProvider.note: AWS private-pricing (EDP) eligibility covers Bedrock only for Amazon Nova and Titan, so Claude discounts come as Anthropic Marketplace private offers (AWS service terms via search extract; medium confidence).

channelFee.note: Distribution fee the cloud keeps. Implied CSP take: ~16% in FY2025 (Reuters: fees >$350M on $2.16B of Amazon+Google sales; S-1 bridge 15.7-16.2%) and 33-36% in 9M 2026, ~32% in Q3 2026, if all channel-partner fees are CSP fees (S-1/A pp. 152-153, 162, F-17). Not split by CSP.

providerServingCost.note: Anthropic cost of revenue per $ of revenue, Q3 2026 ($14.3 per $100; 9M 2026: 14.5%). Includes the cloud margin on capacity.

hostedShare.note: Share of AWS-billed Claude serving that runs on AWS capacity (Trainium for Bedrock; TPU for Vertex).

incrementalComputeShare.note: Share of that compute that is incremental to Anthropic’s take-or-pay AWS commitment (≥$110.0B). If capacity is already committed, serving this customer adds little new AWS revenue.

computeMargin.note: Cloud margin on AI capacity sold to a lab: internal/external TCO ratio 0.65-0.85 (SemiAnalysis InferenceX; Oracle GPU rental 14-16%, target 30-40%).

infraCost.note: n/a for agent route (provider bears serving cost).

distributionCost.note: Platform (API, guardrails), support and account-team cost to distribute, % of list. Cloud opex ex-COGS is ~25% of revenue incl. R&D; AI usage mostly draws down existing commits.

discountFundedByProvider.note: n/a — Microsoft is principal; OpenAI bears its revenue-share percentage of any discount.

revenueShare.note: Since the Apr 27, 2026 amendment Microsoft no longer pays OpenAI a revenue share; CFO: "royalty free with the elimination of our rev share to them" (FY26 Q3 call). Pre-amendment ~20% (The Information: Microsoft keeps 80% of Azure OpenAI sales) is the high case.

infraCost.note: Serving infrastructure per $ of list on Microsoft capacity: OpenAI compute margin on paid users ~70% (The Information via Fortune, Dec 2025), GPU-heavy fleet, deep 2026 price cuts; x0.75 internal/external.

utilization.note: Achieved serving utilization; infra cost scales with 50%/u.

modelDevCost.note: Microsoft holds a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to OpenAI models and products through 2032; it did not fund training per token. High case charges MAI first-party model spend.

distributionCost.note: Foundry platform, support and account team, % of list.

infraCost.note: TPU serving per $ of list: Ironwood internal TCO ~40% below GB200 (SemiAnalysis, reported), offset by intro pricing. Not disclosed by Google.

modelDevCost.note: Gemini development amortized per $ of revenue. Anchors: Alphabet-level activities (mostly frontier-model development) $24.7B TTM spread over all Alphabet revenue is ~6%; a stand-alone lab (Anthropic) spends ~58% of revenue on R&D. Base is a judgement between them.

distributionCost.note: Vertex platform, support and account team, % of list.

customerDiscount.note: Negotiated recurring discount off list. Advisory benchmarks put enterprise commit discounts at 5-20% (Redress, CloudForecast).

discountFundedByProvider.note: Assumed the same as AWS: Anthropic sets price on Vertex. Not verified for Google commit discounts.

channelFee.note: Distribution fee the cloud keeps. Implied CSP take: ~16% in FY2025 (Reuters: fees >$350M on $2.16B of Amazon+Google sales; S-1 bridge 15.7-16.2%) and 33-36% in 9M 2026, ~32% in Q3 2026, if all channel-partner fees are CSP fees (S-1/A pp. 152-153, 162, F-17). Not split by CSP.

providerServingCost.note: Anthropic cost of revenue per $ of revenue, Q3 2026 ($14.3 per $100; 9M 2026: 14.5%). Includes the cloud margin on capacity.

hostedShare.note: Share of Google-billed Claude serving that runs on Google capacity (Trainium for Bedrock; TPU for Vertex).

incrementalComputeShare.note: Share of that compute that is incremental to Anthropic’s take-or-pay Google commitment (≥$121.3B). If capacity is already committed, serving this customer adds little new Google revenue.

computeMargin.note: Cloud margin on AI capacity sold to a lab: internal/external TCO ratio 0.65-0.85 (SemiAnalysis InferenceX; Oracle GPU rental 14-16%, target 30-40%).

distributionCost.note: Platform (API, guardrails), support and account-team cost to distribute, % of list. Cloud opex ex-COGS is ~25% of revenue incl. R&D; AI usage mostly draws down existing commits.

pct.note: Field observation (unverified): ~35% AWS incentive on Anthropic workloads.

partnerFunded.note: Share of the incentive funded by an SI/reseller partner.

providerFunded.note: Share funded by the model provider.

growth.note: Annual growth in a customer’s list-price AI spend on this workload.

retention.note: Probability the AI workload stays on this cloud each year. Cloud account churn ~3%/yr, but ~25% of AI spend switches model each year (Dataiku/Harris; low confidence).

priceDeflation.note: Annual frontier list-price decline, same tier: Opus 5 to 5.5 -20%; GPT Sol -60% in ~10 weeks; Gemini 4 Argon list doubles after intro.

efficiencyGain.note: Annual fall in cost to serve per token: hardware cost/FLOP -27%/yr (Epoch) plus software gains; offset in 2026 by memory and server price rises.

channelFeeDrift.note: Annual change in channel fee (points). Anthropic renegotiated channel terms in 2026 (S&M fell from 22% to 14% of revenue, partly on changed terms).

adjacencyAttach.note: Non-AI cloud revenue per $1 of AI spend (storage, database, networking, CPU sandboxes). No hyperscaler discloses a multiplier.

adjacencyIncremental.note: Share of adjacent revenue that would not exist without the AI win. Base nets to ~$0.20 per $1 (infra research: $0.05-0.60).

adjacencyMargin.note: Gross margin on non-AI cloud services (Microsoft Cloud GM 66% and falling on AI mix; AWS est. ~64% blended).

commitAdjacencyUplift.note: Committed adjacent revenue per $1 of AI spend bought by a commit-conditional credit.

baselineShare.note: Pre-existing spend excluded from consumption credits (0 = net-new).

consumptionYears.note: Years in which spend growth earns consumption credits. AWS MAP: credit % x growth in trailing-12-month spend over the migration plan term (AWS MAP terms, via search extracts); field reports 2-3 year plans.

stake.note: Amazon economic stake in Anthropic after the IPO: ~1.94B Class N shares plus ~1.55B issuable on rollover notes (~3.48B) of ~14.9B (424B4 p. 298). Google ~13%. Microsoft in OpenAI ~27% (reported).

revenueMultiple.note: Anthropic equity value per $1 of run-rate revenue at the $83 IPO price: ~$1.11T / ~$81B Oct 31 run-rate (424B4 p. 203).

incrementalToProvider.note: Share of subsidized consumption that is new revenue for the model provider rather than shifted from its direct channel or another cloud.
